prompt.en: Where do you keep the extra printer paper?
prompt.zh: 多的印表機用紙放在哪裡？

responses.en: It's in the cabinet by the copier.
responses.zh: 在影印機旁邊的櫃子裡。

responses.en: On the second page of the report.
Yes, I'll keep a copy for you.

prompt.en: Have you finished filling out the payroll forms?
prompt.zh: 你的薪資表格填好了嗎？

responses.en: The payroll office is on the second floor.
Yes, it was a really full day.
Almost. I just need to add my bank details.
responses.zh: 快好了，只剩下銀行帳戶資料要填。

prompt.en: Would you rather meet on Tuesday or Wednesday?
prompt.zh: 你比較想星期二還是星期三見面？

responses.en: Yes, I'd like that very much.
Wednesday would be better for me.
We met last Tuesday, didn't we?
responses.zh: 我們上星期二見過面，不是嗎？

prompt.en: Could you send me a quote for three hundred units?
prompt.zh: 可以給我三百件的報價嗎？

responses.en: Sure, I'll email it to you this afternoon.
responses.zh: 沒問題，我今天下午用電子郵件寄給您。

responses.en: There are three hundred people in the hall.
I sent the samples by mail on Monday.
responses.zh: 我星期一把樣品寄出去了。

prompt.en: Why is the storage room locked?
prompt.zh: 儲藏室為什麼鎖起來了？

responses.en: I'll lock it when I leave.
In the room next to the dock.
They're checking the fire alarm until three.
responses.zh: 他們在檢查火災警報器，到三點為止。

prompt.en: How would you like to pay for the room?

responses.en: It's very spacious, thank you.
Can I put it on the company card?
For two nights, please.

prompt.en: Are you taking this suitcase on the plane with you?
prompt.zh: 這個行李箱您要帶上飛機嗎？

responses.en: Yes, the plane landed safely.
It's my first business trip.
No, I'd like to check it, please.

prompt.en: The caterer just called. The food will be an hour late.
prompt.zh: 外燴業者剛剛打來，餐點會晚一個小時到。

responses.en: Then let's do the speeches before dinner.
responses.zh: 那我們就把致詞移到晚餐前。

responses.en: Yes, the food was really good.
It's a late flight from Tokyo.
responses.zh: 那是從東京來的晚班飛機。

prompt.en: Who's going to lead the meeting on Friday?
prompt.zh: 星期五的會議誰要主持？

responses.en: In the conference room on the third floor.
Ms. Carter asked me to do it.
Yes, it starts at ten.

prompt.en: How many boxes would you like to order?

responses.en: Let me check with my manager first.
responses.zh: 我先跟我的主管確認一下。

responses.en: Every box is checked twice.
By the middle of next month.

prompt.en: My order arrived, but two of the plates are broken.
prompt.zh: 我訂的東西到了，可是有兩個盤子破了。

responses.en: Yes, they arrived at two.
We have plates in many sizes.
responses.zh: 我們的盤子有很多尺寸。

responses.en: I'm so sorry. We'll send new ones today.
responses.zh: 非常抱歉，我們今天就寄新的給您。

prompt.en: Did you get your badge from the front desk?
prompt.zh: 你去前台拿識別證了嗎？

responses.en: The desk by the window is mine.
responses.zh: 靠窗的那張桌子是我的。

responses.en: Not yet. I'm going there after lunch.
I got here by train.

prompt.en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
prompt.zh: 您想要靠窗還是靠走道的位子？

responses.en: Either one is fine with me.
Yes, I'd like a seat, please.
I'll open the window for you.

prompt.en: I'm afraid your room isn't ready yet.
prompt.zh: 不好意思，您的房間還沒準備好。

responses.en: I already read that report.
responses.zh: 我已經看過那份報告了。

responses.en: Room 405, on the fourth floor.
Could I leave my bags with you until it is?
responses.zh: 那在房間好之前，我可以把行李寄放在你們這裡嗎？

prompt.en: Why don't we have lunch after the meeting?
prompt.zh: 我們開完會一起吃午餐吧？

responses.en: Because the meeting was moved.
Good idea. There's a nice place nearby.
responses.zh: 好主意，附近有一家不錯的店。

responses.en: He's in a meeting right now.

prompt.en: Shouldn't we load the rush order first?
prompt.zh: 我們不是應該先裝急件嗎？

responses.en: I placed that order last week.
responses.zh: 那張訂單是我上星期下的。

responses.en: Sorry, I was in a rush this morning.
Yes, the customer needs it by noon.

lines.en: Good morning. Before your tour, I need you to sign up for the health plan.
lines.zh: 早安。在帶你參觀之前，你要先登記健康保險方案。

lines.en: Sure. Is there a deadline for that?
lines.zh: 好的。這個有截止日期嗎？

lines.en: Yes. The form has to be in by Friday, or you'll have to wait until next year.
lines.zh: 有。表格要在星期五前交，不然就要等到明年。

lines.en: Then I'll fill it out during lunch. Can I keep this handbook?
lines.zh: 那我午餐時間來填。這本員工手冊我可以留著嗎？

lines.en: Of course, it's yours. Read the part about vacation days when you have time.
lines.zh: 當然，那是你的。有空的時候看一下休假那一段。

questions.en: What must the man do by Friday?
questions.zh: 男子星期五前必須做什麼？
options: Take a tour of the building
Give back the handbook
Turn in a form for the health plan
Read about vacation days

questions.en: What can be learned about the health plan?
questions.zh: 從對話中可以得知健康保險方案的什麼事？
options: Its form must be returned during lunch.
Workers can join it only at certain times.
The man has already signed up for it.
It starts after the man's tour.

lines.en: Hello, Ms. Carter. Did you get our quote for the office chairs?
lines.zh: Carter 小姐您好。您收到我們辦公椅的報價了嗎？

lines.en: I did, thanks. The price is fine, but we need the chairs before the end of May.
lines.zh: 收到了，謝謝。價格沒問題，可是我們五月底前就需要那些椅子。

lines.en: Well, we could deliver half of them in two weeks and the rest in June.
lines.zh: 這樣的話，我們可以兩週內先送一半，剩下的六月送。

lines.en: That might work. Let me talk to my director and call you back this afternoon.
lines.zh: 這樣可能可以。我跟我們總經理談一下，今天下午回電給你。

questions.en: What is the woman concerned about?
options: The chairs may arrive too late.
The price of the chairs is too high.
Half of the chairs are missing.
The quote has not come yet.

questions.en: What will the woman most likely do this afternoon?
questions.zh: 女子今天下午最有可能做什麼？
options: Pay for half of the chairs
Cancel the whole order
Ask the man for a new quote
Phone the man after a discussion

lines.en: How's the inventory count going?
lines.zh: 庫存盤點進行得怎麼樣？

lines.en: Not great. The list says sixty boxes of paper cups, but I only found fifty.
lines.zh: 不太順。清單上寫紙杯有六十箱，可是我只找到五十箱。

lines.en: Did you look on the shelves near the loading dock? We moved some boxes there last week.
lines.zh: 你有看裝卸區旁邊的架子嗎？我們上星期把一些箱子搬到那裡了。

lines.en: No, I didn't. I'll go and check right now.
lines.zh: 沒有，我沒看。我現在就去確認。

questions.en: What problem does the man mention?
options: Some paper cups are broken.
Some boxes cannot be found.
The loading dock is closed.
The inventory list is missing.

questions.en: How many boxes of cups did the man find?
options: Ten
Fifteen
Sixty
Fifty

lines.en: Attention, passengers on Flight 316 to Tokyo.
lines.zh: 搭乘 316 班機前往東京的旅客請注意。

lines.en: Because of a storm, our departure time has changed from two fifteen to four thirty.
lines.zh: 由於暴風雨，起飛時間從兩點十五分改為四點半。

lines.en: We are sorry for the delay. Passengers may pick up a meal voucher at the airline counter next to gate nine.
lines.zh: 造成延誤，我們深感抱歉。旅客可以到九號登機門旁的航空公司櫃台領取餐券。

lines.en: Please keep your boarding pass with you, and listen for further announcements.
lines.zh: 請隨身攜帶登機證，並留意後續廣播。

options: Gate nine is closed.
Some passengers are not here yet.
The weather is bad.
The crew is still on another plane.

questions.en: What can passengers get at the counter next to gate nine?
questions.zh: 旅客可以在九號登機門旁的櫃台拿到什麼？
options: A ticket for free food
A new boarding pass
A seat on an earlier flight
A map of the terminal

lines.en: The copier on our floor isn't working again.
lines.zh: 我們這層的影印機又壞了。

lines.en: Again? I called the technician yesterday, and he said it was fixed.
lines.zh: 又壞了？我昨天才打給技術人員，他說已經修好了。

lines.en: Well, it stops after every few pages. I need fifty copies of the sales report for the two o'clock meeting.
lines.zh: 可是它每印幾頁就停。兩點的會議我需要五十份銷售報告。

lines.en: Use the one upstairs for now. I'll call the technician again.
lines.zh: 先用樓上那台吧。我會再打給技術人員。

questions.en: What does the man need to do before two o'clock?
questions.zh: 男子兩點前需要做什麼？
options: Call the technician
Make copies of a report
Repair the copier on his own
Write a sales report

questions.en: Where will the man most likely go next?
questions.zh: 男子接下來最有可能去哪裡？
options: To the meeting room
To the technician's office
To the woman's desk
To the floor above

lines.en: Hi, I ordered twenty lamps from you, and three of them arrived broken.
lines.zh: 你好，我跟你們訂了二十盞燈，有三盞送到的時候是壞的。

lines.en: I'm so sorry about that. Could you give me your order number?
lines.zh: 真的很抱歉。可以給我您的訂單編號嗎？

lines.en: It's 4517. I need all twenty for a hotel opening on Saturday.
lines.zh: 是 4517。星期六有一間飯店開幕，二十盞我全部都要用。

lines.en: I see it here. We'll send three new ones today, and they'll get there on Thursday.
lines.zh: 我看到了。我們今天就寄三盞新的過去，星期四會送到。

lines.en: Thank you. That's a relief.
lines.zh: 謝謝，這樣我就放心了。

options: Some items were damaged.
Some lamps never arrived.
He wants to cancel an order.
He lost his order number.

questions.en: What is suggested about the new lamps?
questions.zh: 關於新的燈，對話中暗示了什麼？
options: They will cost the man extra.
They will be sent on Saturday.
They will arrive before the hotel opens.
They are a different model.

lines.en: Hi, I'm in room 512. The air conditioner is making a loud noise, and I can't sleep.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 512 號房。冷氣一直發出很大的聲音，我睡不著。

lines.en: I'm sorry. Our technician has gone home for the night. Would you like to move to another room?
lines.zh: 很抱歉，我們的技術人員今晚已經下班了。您要不要換到別的房間？

lines.en: Yes, please. Do you have one on a quiet floor?
lines.zh: 好，麻煩你。有沒有在安靜樓層的房間？

lines.en: Room 708 is free. It's a suite, but we won't charge you anything extra.
lines.zh: 708 號房是空的。那是套房，不過我們不會多收您任何費用。

questions.en: What problem does the man report?
options: His room is on a busy floor.
He was given the wrong room.
His key card does not work.
A machine in his room is too loud.

questions.en: What does the woman offer the man?
options: A visit from a technician tonight
A better room for the same price
A lower price for his next stay
A free breakfast in the morning

lines.en: Hi, this is Tom from Bayside Supplies, calling for Ms. Carter.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Bayside Supplies 的 Tom，找 Carter 小姐。

lines.en: We got your order for two hundred boxes of printer paper.
lines.zh: 我們收到您兩百箱影印紙的訂單了。

lines.en: Unfortunately, we only have one hundred and twenty in stock right now.
lines.zh: 很遺憾，我們現在只有一百二十箱庫存。

lines.en: We can send those tomorrow and the rest next Wednesday.
lines.zh: 我們可以明天先寄這些，剩下的下星期三寄。

lines.en: If that doesn't work for you, please call me back before five today. Thanks.
lines.zh: 如果這樣不行，請在今天五點前回電給我。謝謝。

options: To ask for a payment
To change the price of the paper
To give a new phone number
To say an order will come in two parts

questions.en: How many boxes will be sent next Wednesday?
options: Twenty
Eighty
One hundred and twenty
Two hundred
